Revision 329 (source mockup deepseek_html_20260927_7fc18d.html "场景名片"): added a real, checkin-gated scene rating system (internal/scenereview — SubmitSceneReview requires the rater's own real checkin history to include this sceneId, one review per (scene, rater), UNIQUE(scene_id, rater_id) enforces overwrite-not-stack) wired into realityscene.Scene/Detail via a small ratingLookup interface (SetRatingLookup) that only attaches Rating/RatingCount when a real aggregate with count > 0 exists — mirrors marketplace's CLIENT-RATING-001 pattern exactly. Added an authenticated ListSceneCompanionSuggestions command (also in internal/realityscene) that replaces the public, anonymous, cached GetDetail/Humans FIXTURE (Mai/Linh/Trang, already honestly labeled Source=FIXTURE) for logged-in viewers only: it intersects the viewer's real active friends (relationship.Service.ListActiveFriends) against two real signals — real checkin history at that scene (new realityscene.Repository.FilterKnownVisitors) and real activity participation at that scene (new activity.Repository/Service.FilterKnownParticipants, querying activity.activities.payload->>'realitySceneId' joined to activity.participants). Both new filter methods are deliberately designed as candidate-only membership tests — they can only confirm which of a caller-supplied id set has a real signal, never enumerate who does, so they cannot be used to leak a roster to a caller who does not already know the candidates. This was a live design change during the session: real participant data was almost wired directly into the public cached endpoint, which would have broadcast real users' attendance to anonymous callers; caught before implementation, moved to a new authenticated command instead. The public Detail.Humans FIXTURE is unchanged and remains the fallback when the viewer is unauthenticated or has zero real hits. Ported the existing scene-shop-directory.tsx photo-wall pattern (localnet-client.ts's listPostsAtScene, login-gated) into reality-scene-map.tsx as a new section; deliberately did not replicate the mockup's 全部/环境/菜单/用户精选 tab split or 官方/用户精选 curation badges — no such curation pipeline exists anywhere in the codebase (photos are undifferentiated scene-tagged posts), so the tabs would have been fabricated structure.
